description: Figure 2, titled "Ever-scalingness," is a circular diagram divided into four colored quadrants, each representing a key desideratum for a benchmark. The top-left quadrant, colored yellow, is labeled "Uncrushable" and contains the text "Complexity" and an icon of a ladder. The top-right quadrant, colored light blue, is labeled "Unhackable" and contains the text "Instance" and a shield icon. The bottom-right quadrant, colored green, is labeled "General" and contains the text "Coverage" and a globe icon. The bottom-left quadrant, colored red, is labeled "Auto-verifiable" and contains the text "Scalable Oversight" and a document icon. The four quadrants are arranged around a central white circle, and the overall diagram is enclosed by a larger white circle.
